title: Kruskal's algorithm returns a subset of its input edges
statement: Fix $n \in \bbn$ and a list of weighted edges over $n$ vertices. Every edge returned by running Kruskal's algorithm on this list occurs in the original list: if $e$ belongs to the output of $\mathtt{kruskal}\,n\,\mathit{edges}$, then $e$ belongs to $\mathit{edges}$.
hypotheses_covered: a list of weighted edges over n vertices
e is a member of the output of kruskal n edges
replaced:
Every edge $e$ returned by $\mathtt{kruskal}\,n\,\mathit{edges}$ was already
present in $\mathit{edges}$: if $e \in \mathtt{kruskal}\,n\,\mathit{edges}$
then $e \in \mathit{edges}$.
